text:
michael: Heads-up — planning to enable specter-13b-quantv2 in the model catalog tonight during the 00:00-02:00 UTC changewindow. Need sign-off on fallback ordering and priming behavior.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @michael for 3519993600. Canary targets: 5% for 20 minutes, then 25% for 30 minutes. Automated rollback on error-rate > 2% or p95 latency > 1.2s.

anya: quick Q — do we want automatic KV/prefix priming for the canary? That will spike a bit of traffic but reduces cold-start latency.

jen: +1 priming for canary only. Don't prime EU region until we confirm p95 on NA. EU had higher mem pressure last week.

paul: fallback ordering proposal (from runtime):
```yaml
fallback_order:
  - specter-13b-quantv2
  - specter-13b-quant
  - specter-13b
priming: canary_only
cache_ttl_seconds: 300
```
This keeps quantv2 preferred but falls back to quant if needed.

michael: Looks good. I want an explicit deferment flag for regional priming — we should not prime eu until ops-sre gives the go.

ops-sre: Confirmed — we'll watch NA canary, then give a go/no-go for EU priming. If we see memory churn > 70% on quantv2, we will ask for an immediate drain.

carol: Suggest adding a pin window for the first 2 hours so we can easily rollback to previous catalog pin if something odd shows up. e.g. pin = specter-13b:20260301 -> revert quickly.

anya: Also adding a safety TTL for fallback promotion to avoid oscillation: if fallback used, keep it for 10 minutes before attempting promotion back.

michael: Good idea. Final checklist before deploy: (1) deploy-bot schedule locked, (2) priming = canary_only, eu_priming = defer, (3) fallback_order as Paul posted, (4) pin fallback target for 2h, (5) telemetry: token-level latency, model-fallback-rate, mem pressure.

jen: I'll wire up the telemetry dashboards and alerts (p95 heatmap + fallback-rate). ETA 40m.

deploy-bot: NOTE: preflight checks passed. All canary machines ready. Starting rollout at scheduled time unless someone aborts.

paul: Minor config snippet for deploybot (to paste into release config):
```json
{"model":"specter-13b-quantv2","canary_pct":5,"canary_minutes":20,"fallback_policy":"quant_then_full","priming":"canary_only","eu_priming":"defer"}
```

michael: OK — proceeding. If anyone sees anything abnormal after first canary tranche ping here and call for rollback. :thumbsup:

ops-sre: We'll monitor. Oncall ready.

carol: leaving a reminder to update release notes with the priming/deferment behavior so customers know why EU might see different latencies for a bit.

anya: thanks — I'll add the note.

michael: closing thread — deploy in progress at 3519993600. Will update with canary outcome.
